decision: interleave verified response attestation inside each request lifecycle and require pending -> verified -> resolved before qualification

correctness.winner: causal event ordering plus completed-lifecycle qualification
correctness.reason: request-id membership proves correlation but not that every attestation used for readiness belongs to a request that reached durable resolution

security.winner: collector fail-closed lifecycle validation plus qualification cross-check
security.reason: rejects verified-before-pending, verified-after-resolved, duplicate verification, duplicate pending, resolve-without-pending, and verified requests left unresolved

performance.reason: adds no qrexec round trips, daemon, database, or production mutation; cost is linear event validation and small request-id sets

regressionRisk.winner: explicit resolved-lifecycle check in the existing attested evaluator
regressionRisk.reason: keeps MissionQueue, coordinator, transport, and durable journal semantics unchanged while making readiness fail closed

rejected.failure: proves correlation but not causal lifecycle completion
indirectly implies completion but does not make attestation lifecycle completion an explicit independently auditable readiness condition

rejected.approach: durable attestation journal in coordinator state
rejected.failure: adds persistence and recovery complexity before offline evidence is exhausted
stronger trust boundary but adds deployment, key lifecycle, IPC, latency, and regression surface before real Qubes execution is available

qa: verified response must occur after request_pending and before request_resolved
every campaign attestation used for readiness must be present in both verifiedRequestIds and resolvedRequestIds
duplicate attestation for one request is rejected
crash/retry recovery attestation remains inside the original request lifecycle
lease fencing and QA evidence remain independent correctness gates
lesson: qualification should encode critical causal invariants directly even when another aggregate counter currently implies the same outcome; explicit gates survive future refactors and are easier to audit
safety: synthetic defensive qualification only; no real financial transactions or payment data
